meta.title: noergo — a visual memory for you and your AI agents
meta.description: Boards, mind maps and a knowledge graph in one place. ChatGPT, Claude and Grok read and organise it with you, live.

auth.title: Sign in to noergo
auth.free: Free to use. No card needed.
auth.notConfigured: No sign-in method is configured on this server. See docs/configuration.md.

errors.account_not_linked: This e-mail already has a noergo account. Sign in with the method you used the first time.
errors.email_unverified: Your provider did not confirm that this e-mail is yours. Try another account, or ask your organisation's administrator.
errors.email_missing: This account did not share an e-mail address. Use an account that has one.
errors.signup_closed: Sign-up on this server is by invitation. Ask its administrator to add your e-mail.
